display_name: LoRa W24 同等剂量与修正上限源域诊断
description: Compare frozen learned half readout with source-only exact-noise controls at learned magnitude, at model cap, and with complete center-only subtraction.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal authorizes strictly isolated source diagnostics with simulated noise components.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Prior frozen exact source-packet replay and original same-packet clean/direct/half coordinates.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered source Native Full and native_residual_w24_v1; source-only isolated trace.

permissions.claim_scope: Zero training, model selection or target paths. Exact noise consumed solely by diagnostic counterfactuals after frozen-source model binding.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original compliant frozen source models, no dynamic weights, no training or calibration.
checkpoint.selection_rule: No candidate selection; confirm one registered source comparison. None of the exact-noise variants are target candidates.

execution.gpu_policy: One GPU, 5 then 6,3,0; actual free memory at least 12 GiB; 8 CPU workers.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on role, checkpoint, physical order, exact trace parity, actual edit cap, output shape, paired control parity or matrix coverage failure.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_edit_budget_audit score-source and the existing frozen source scorer

rows.method: Direct, frozen outer_half, exact same-dose noise direction, capped noise direction, exact projected noise subtraction, complete center-noise removal. Each preserves measured edges.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: One source-only frozen 300-packet panel per route; zero parameter updates.

notes: Exact noise controls are isolated from any candidate training or deployment.

Same-dose matches the learned RMS on nonzero projected-noise cells. Report undefined and overshoot counts. Capped and projected-exact rows share the same carrier projection; comparison with complete center subtraction isolates restoring its removed component.
None of the diagnostic counterparts are eligible for formal test. Maintaining the active overarching target.
